We need to update the consent procedure to include SIS entry and offer electronic translated forms before approval. I agree with my colleagues that all four concerns raised today should be addressed in the revised plan, and I'd support Dr. Singh holding approval until those updates are made.

Replace student-selected tutor pairings with counselor-assigned and monitored pairings to ensure compliance with no-contact restrictions.
Change communication platform from Google Classroom to the district-approved Microsoft Teams education environment.
